description: Windows companion for the Launcher Android app, providing local-network notes and shared-file access.
notes: The official Windows download is a self-contained win-x64 .NET single-file executable; Scoop downloads it directly and does not run an installer.

The app stores its server certificate under %LOCALAPPDATA%\LauncherCompanion. A guarded junction maps that exact folder to Scoop's persistent data\LauncherCompanion directory; Scoop removes the junction on uninstall but retains the persisted data.
The launcher sets DOTNET_BUNDLE_EXTRACT_BASE_DIR to data\dotnet so .NET single-file native-library extraction is kept in Scoop's persistent data.
Keep the Launcher Companion console window open while the phone is connected; closing it stops the local server.
The executable is not Authenticode-signed. No LICENSE file or license declaration was found upstream, so the manifest uses license Unknown.

The publisher's download URL contains an opaque per-upload identifier. The upstream project file provides a valid version source for checkver, but no safe version-derived download URL is available for autoupdate.
post_install: if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($actualTarget) -or [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($actualTarget) -ine [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($persistData)) { throw 'LauncherCompanion LocalAppData path is already a reparse point with an unexpected or unknown target; leaving it unchanged.' }
} else { throw 'Both LauncherCompanion LocalAppData and Scoop persistent data contain files; neither was overwritten.' }

if (($junction.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint) -eq 0 -or [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($junctionTarget) -or [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($junctionTarget) -ine [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($persistData)) { throw 'LauncherCompanion LocalAppData junction does not resolve to Scoop persistent data.' }
pre_uninstall: if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($actualTarget) -or [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($actualTarget) -ine [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($persistData)) { throw 'Refusing to remove the LauncherCompanion LocalAppData reparse point because its target is not the Scoop persistent folder.' }
